'''Ilia Orpin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi historian|historian]] and the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]]. Providing an extensive account of the Order's history and origins, Orpin's greatest work was titled the "[[Revan Mythologies]]." Many of the stories contained in the mythologies tell tales of a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], and how their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] came to dominate [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] through the use of exotic machinery and [[Rakatan ship|hyperspace-capable ships]] that employed [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a power source. Jedi heroes in the Revan Mythologies often discover Rakatan devices of immense power, and were forced to choose between destroying the devices or being corrupted by their power. In the wake of the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the destruction of the Jedi, Orpin's work was oft dismissed by [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] as myth and legends. These scholars believed that the mythologies were an updated derivative reworking of the [[Qel-Droma Epics/Legends|Qel-Droma Epics]] to better acculturate [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]] of the day.<ref name="NoP" />
